name: The Witch of Flower and Hope
source:
Not all tales are glorified, not all endings are noble. The story of how two kingdoms finally came together, a single life was the final piece to their happily ever after.

Made for TyranoBuilder Spring Game Jam 2017

[From [url=https://shuyafay.itch.io/the-witch-of-flower-and-hope]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不是所有的故事都是美好的，不是所有的结局都是高贵的。两个王国最终走到一起的故事，一个人的生活是他们幸福生活的最后一部分。

专为TyranoBuilder 2017年春季Game Jam制作

[来自[url=https://shuyafay.itch.io/the-witch-of-flower-and-hope]Itch.io[/url]]
